purpose: Metadata-only exhaustive GaiaDR3 positional association for433 frozen RubinDiaObjects, exclude20 development identities and counterparts, retain independently eligible stellar associations for main photometry freeze.

gaia_query.retry: Same request only for5xx/timeouts; no auth or denial bypass
gaia_query.prefilter: None other than field. All Gaia neighbor classes retained.

association.target_epoch: Each Rubin midpointMjdTai convertedTAI->TCB Julianyear. Rubin object coordinates are assumed representative of contemporaneous astrometry; precise object reference epoch absent, recorded limitation.
association.propagation: Gaia ICRS positions and proper motions from ref_epoch; astropy spherical apply_space_motion; finite positive parallax supplies distance, finiteRV or zeroRV; noPM catalog positions retained as uncertainty neighbors but cannot qualify as sole match.
association.unique_rule: Exactly1 Gaia source within1arcsec and exactly1 within2arcsec, with finitePM for matching source. All neighbor solutions including noPM enter ambiguity check.
association.field_margin: 0.1deg=360arcsec beyond Rubin0.5deg cone atGaia2016epoch. Catalog completeness conditional on motion less thanmargin over epoch baseline; no claim beyond catalog/field/measurement limits.

stellar_evidence.pm_metric: sqrt(mu.T inverse(C_pm) mu), finite positivePMerrors and validcorrelation; otherwise unavailable.
stellar_evidence.rule: parallaxSNR>=3 ORPMjointSigma>=5. No nearest-only association called stellar proof.
stellar_evidence.quality_flags: ruwe,duplicated_source,astrometric_params_solved retained descriptively; no posthoc threshold tuning

development_exclusion.mainGaiaDuplicates: keep smallest exact numericDiaID among otherwise eligible rows; excludeothers with reason

sort: All eligible main rows ordered by validpositive parallax withSNR>=3 inverse distance1000/parallax pc ascending, then exact integerDiaObjectId; eligiblePM-only/uncertain-distance rows placedlast byID. Max500; original pool413. No Rubin flux/anomaly sorting.
limitations: Alert-selected bounded cone/time sample, not allstars or allsky.
Association and stellar-evidence selection does not establish>=50 photometrically evaluable objects.
Missing or ambiguous motion/neighbor evidence remains explicit rejection.
Gaia parallax distance is only rankingproxy, no inference ofunbiased distanceposterior orzero-pointcorrected distance.
